_comment: Maps provider names to icon filenames. The provider name is extracted from model IDs automatically.
_alias_note: model_prefix_aliases are matched (startswith) BEFORE region-prefix stripping and before the split-on-first-dot fallback. They are required for two cases the dot-split cannot handle: (1) ids with no provider segment at all, e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022', 'grok-4-latest', 'kimi-k2-0905'; (2) ids whose version contains a literal dot, e.g. 'glm-4.5' — without the 'glm-' alias that would split into a bogus provider 'glm-4'. The 'moonshotai.' alias maps that vendor segment onto the existing moonshot.png. Do not remove these without re-checking those ids.
_glm_note: GLM/ChatGLM ships under several vendor segments: 'glm' (bare 'glm-4.5' via alias), 'zai' (Z.ai / Zhipu, e.g. 'zai.glm-4.7-flash'). All map to glm.png. Add 'zhipu' here too if a gateway ever serves that segment.
